phrase.zh: 让声音保留自己的棱角。
phrase.en: Let a sound keep its own edges.

visual.zh: 手指、琴弦和几何色块把演奏转成有力度的节奏。这里的自由表达是一种艺术主题，不表示所有摇滚作品都持有相同的社会立场。
visual.en: Fingers, strings and geometric shapes turn performance into visual rhythm. Freedom of expression is the artistic theme, rather than a claim that all rock music shares one social position.

background.zh: 摇滚名人堂介绍，吉米·亨德里克斯体验乐队从蓝调根基出发，把反馈声和录音室的声像、反向播放及相位处理纳入创作。电吉他的意义因此不只在旋律，也在于演奏者如何主动塑造音色。
background.en: The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame describes the Jimi Hendrix Experience combining blues foundations with feedback and studio techniques such as panning, reversed recording and phasing. The electric guitar became a way to shape timbre as well as play melody.

sources.label: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame · Jimi Hendrix Experience
